v4_manifest.description: Final checkpoint of the nine-hour PPO run initialized from the 43-minute imitation checkpoint.
v4_manifest.selection: Final nine-hour checkpoint; also selected by the recorded held-out validation procedure.

protocol.timing: Training pipeline wall time only; excludes collection, validation, checkpoint writes and recovery downtime
protocol.selection: Equal mean of targeted, training_campaigns and heldout monitor scores; Lantern excluded. Confirm best monitor candidate and V4 on independent 20-seed campaign/target panels.
protocol.visibility: Authored arena variants; broad campaign fog is player-only; targeted player/both fog explicitly selected by variant

selection.criterion: Mean targeted / training-campaign / heldout completion; fewer caps break ties. Independent confirmation. Lantern excluded.

limitations: Two thirds of the recorded selection score is from training maps on separate seeds; it is not a generalization-only ranking.
The recorded mixed-score winner was not promoted as the strongest general policy or deployed.
Monitor campaigns/target conditions have eight seeds, final confirmation twenty.
Held-out arenas use the authored representative faction/initiative schedules, not exhaustive crossplay.
Selection weights targeted, training-campaign and held-out scores equally; Lantern never selects.
Independent confirmation compares only the monitor-best trained checkpoint and V4.
This experiment measures the combined architecture and imitation curriculum, not an isolated GRU benefit.
Checkpoints remain experimental; no deployed/default planner was changed.
interpretation: Targeted generalization to fresh combat seeds improved, while broader gameplay and Lantern regressed. Recorded mixed-score selection is not overall-strength selection. No model promoted.
